About ESIMA Concept Enterprise

Build Smart! Live Better! — Clean, safe and sustainable water & sanitation solutions.

Our Story

Waste Management & Water Should Be Clean, Safe & Sustainable

At ESIMA CONCEPT ENTERPRISE, we believe waste management and water should be clean, safe, and sustainable. We specialize in the design and installation of Biodigester Systems, Chamberless Clean-Out Systems, Professional Plumbing, and Complete Water Treatment Systems.

Unlike conventional septic tanks, our systems are non-polluting, odourless, require no evacuation, and are built to last. Whether it's a single bungalow, a duplex, an estate, or a commercial facility, we deliver efficient solutions tailored to your site and soil condition. We are committed to quality workmanship, affordable pricing, and excellent after-service support.

Our Services

Four core solutions, tailored to your site and soil condition.

A

Biodigester System

Modern sewage treatment system that replaces septic tanks.

  • No odour, no evacuation
  • Eco-friendly & space-saving
  • Built to last longer
  • Ideal for all soil types — including waterlogged areas like Bayelsa, Delta & Rivers States
B

Chamberless Clean-Out System

Advanced drainage inspection and maintenance system without concrete chambers.

  • Prevents blockages
  • Easier to maintain
  • Neat, professional finishing
C

Professional Plumbing Services

Complete plumbing for new buildings and maintenance for existing properties.

  • Pipe laying & sanitary fittings
  • Water supply & drainage
  • Neat and lasting installation
D

Complete Water Treatment System

We treat borehole water to make it clean, odour-free and safe for domestic and industrial use.

  • Iron removal, purification, softening & filtration
  • We also set up Sachet & Bottle Water Factories
